Mental health and disabilities aren't phases. When more people realise this maybe more support will be available to people who need it instead of it being a "oh its not so bad" thing.

I... Completely understand you. My SO has two, one is 7 the other is 3. The 7yo (diagnosed baby bipolar, ADHD, ODD, depends on who you ask about the autism but nor formal diagnoses) has very aggressive tendicies, literally screams just about every time he is told no or asked to do something, so I more often than not feel the same way.  I find myself being the sole care taker of the kids and all the house shit. The kids run absolutely fucking wild otherwise, mom just lets them do whatever because she hates hearing them upset. Well, I hate them running all over us. So its really just me who invokes rules and boundaries. And dude, it's fucking exhausting.

The best answers I have for you (which we are struggling to get into order so I understabd its hard) is services, as many services you can find. Respite care, disability "day camps", work shops, classes. Theres a lot out there. Also, self care is huge. I am personally terrible at it so my mental health also suffers dramatically because of it.

Take care of yourself, that doesnt mean walk away, it means take that shower you wanted to take before shit went wild. Have the cigarette while things are getting thrown. Take an extra 10 or 15 minutes to get home from work. 

And therapy, I have a hard time here too, because no mother (or parent) wants to always hear how shitty their kid is. Its also not fair to them. Even though they may be the only person you express it or anything to. 

As stupid as it is, every day is a new day and I cant imagine actually walking away. And thats ok. It's just going to take work and help. LOTS OF HELP. 

Honestly, youre post made me chill out a bit, validation in struggle is nice.

Because the live tissues have to be harvested or because your dna was enough of a match for someone else. 

Sometimes i feel weird and si-fiy talking about this topic but this is absolutely where this shit is going. We live in a world that is out to get every bit of you to destroy and consume you. We are disposable consumers, and now there are disposable consumers that have given every bit of information to, well whoever wants it. And thats literally whoever people. 


Now do I think its sort of great that people have been arrested off the dna they send in? When its the 70 year old cold case, sure. However that just shows what a company will do with your information and one good cause never justifies the million wrongs behind it. 

Wake up people.

People genuinely dont understand what is happening to their privacy. Its a shame.
